description: This file provides a Python interface to the Linux prctl system call, including capability and security bits management, with classes and functions for manipulating process security attributes.

classes.name: Capbset
classes.description: Class for managing capability bounding set, allowing dropping and limiting capabilities.

classes.name: Capset
classes.description: Class for managing capability sets with different flags (effective, inheritable, permitted), allowing dropping and limiting capabilities.

classes.name: Securebits
classes.description: Class for managing securebits flags, allowing getting and setting specific security bits.

methods.name: prctl_wrapper
methods.description: Creates a wrapper function for a specific prctl option.

methods.name: capb_wrapper
methods.description: Creates getter and setter for capability bounding set.

methods.name: cap_wrapper
methods.description: Creates getter and setter for capability sets.

methods.name: sec_wrapper
methods.description: Creates getter and setter for security bits.

methods.name: _parse_caps_simple
methods.description: Parses a list of capability names or values into capability constants.

methods.name: _parse_caps
methods.description: Parses arguments into capability sets with optional flags.

methods.name: get_caps
methods.description: Retrieves capabilities based on parsed arguments.

methods.name: set_caps
methods.description: Sets capabilities based on parsed arguments.
